query:
SELECT id, name, latin_name, wikidata_qid, conservation_status
FROM plants
WHERE wikidata_qid IS NOT NULL AND conservation_status IN ('CR', 'EN', 'VU')
ORDER BY FIELD(conservation_status, 'CR', 'EN', 'VU')
LIMIT 10;
